identification: Two tubs of fishing DVDs plus a box of fishing books. DVDs include Adventure Angler with Micah Adams (series 3, 4 and a box set), Fishing DVD magazine No. 17, Leviathan, Sport Fish DVD Vol. 6 and Vol. 3, Squidgy Secrets parts, Strikezone, Ultimate Fishing Vol. 2, Highland Gold (Tasmanian fly-fishing techniques), Hooked on Snapper and Tuna, Big Boat Big Fish and others. Books include Jack Pollard's Australian Fishing, Complete Book of Australian Fishing (Hungerford), Anglers' Omnibus, Rigby's Fishing, Australian and New Zealand Fishing, The Saltwater Fisherman's Bible, How to Catch a Fish (Hungerford).
